This is a square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. It holds a small piece of fish, probably salmon with a topping, about 80-100 g. There are two small broccoli florets, about 70-80 g, and 5-6 cherry or grape tomatoes, about 60-70 g.

The fish comes to roughly 90 g at about 200 kcal/100 g, so about 180 kcal. The broccoli is about 75 g at 30 kcal, so about 25 kcal. The tomatoes are about 65 g, so about 12 kcal. Visible oil or topping adds about 30 kcal.

That gives about 245 kcal and about 230 g.
